summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of BUZZ-AI Stage 2-4 (Access Control, AI Participant, CRM Settings/Budgets). All core functionality verified working correctly.

minor_issues.issue: Test script expected HTTP 200 for POST operations, but API correctly returns 201 (CREATED)
minor_issues.impact: False test failures - not an actual bug
minor_issues.note: This is proper REST API design. Test script needs update to accept 201 for POST operations.

passed_tests: GET /api/comments/feed/access NEVER returns 403 (returns {allowed} correctly)
GET /api/comments/topic/all returns 403 for users without membership
GET /api/comments/topic/all returns 200 for admin users (bypass works)
POST /api/comments/:page returns 403 without membership
POST /api/comments/answer/:id returns 403 without membership
PUT /api/comments/like/:id returns 403 without membership
GET /api/news/item/:id is public (not gated by 403)
GET /api/calendar/events is public (returns 200 without auth)
POST /api/comments/topic/:id/ai-reply creates SYSTEM_AI comment with authorType=SYSTEM_AI
AI usage events created with operationType=buzz_thread_reply, billingContext=INTERNAL, creditsCharged=0, providerCostUsd>0
SYSTEM_AI comments persisted in MongoDB (5 comments found)
@FOMOAI mention triggers reply creation (reply created successfully with 201)
GET /api/comments/admin/ai/settings returns all expected fields
PATCH /api/comments/admin/ai/settings updates settings correctly
GET /api/comments/admin/ai/budget returns spend metrics computed from ai_usage_events
POST /api/comments/topic/:id/summary/regenerate returns READY status with providerCostUsd>0 and creditsCharged=0
Admin/moderator bypass works for BuzzAccessGuard
Real OpenAI API integration working (dataMode=real, costStatus=REAL)
COGS tracking working correctly (providerCostUsd tracked in ai_usage_events)
INTERNAL billing never charges user credits (creditsCaptured=0, creditsCharged=0)

details.feed_access_endpoint: NEVER returns 403, returns {allowed: false} without auth, {allowed: true} with admin
details.gated_endpoints: All return 403 with code BUZZ_FEED_ACCESS_REQUIRED for users without membership
details.public_endpoints: News and Calendar are public (not gated)

details.cooldown_settings: cooldownSec configurable (set to 0 in current settings, updated to 30 in test)

details.get_settings: Returns all expected fields (autoReplyEnabled, mentionsEnabled, minComments, etc.)
details.get_budget: Returns computed spend from ai_usage_events (daySpendUsd: 0.060246, monthSpendUsd: 0.060246)
details.summary_regenerate: Returns READY status with providerCostUsd=0.0004716, creditsCharged=0
